messages:
Maya Chen: Dropping the latest smallframes for the embeddings + rerank preview export. Link: https://figma.redwood/vec-mini2. Need quick pass on: toolbar behavior when multi-selecting, export CTA wording, and SR announcements.

Ibrahim Noor: Looks good. Two quick asks: keep Export label stable (just 'Export') with a visible count chip; SR should get full context via sr-only text 'Export 5 vectors'. Also avoid moving primary actions into kebab on tablet.

Sofia Park: Accessibility: use role=list/listitem and roving tabindex on rows. Add a polite live region that says '5 vectors selected' on change. When rerank slider changes, announce 'Relevance scores updated'.

Kenji Watanabe: Mobile: propose stacked toolbar when selections >6. Keep Reorder + Export visible; others in overflow. For compact state keep touch targets >=44px. Also, in the export modal show a 3-row CSV preview and the header mapping label 'Auto-detected header: text' with an Edit action.

a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) roving tabindex sample; 2) polite live region for selection and rerank updates; 3) sr-only export label with count; 4) focus trap in export modal; 5) contrast check for count chip >=4.5:1.

Maya Chen: Thanks — action items: @Kenji mock stacked toolbar frames; @Sofia add roving tabindex code snippet; @Ibrahim finalize modal microcopy. I'll pull together and push an updated Figma by Thursday.
